_comment: Claude Code Preview launch definitions. The backend uses the venv-installed Python at backend/.venv/bin/python (created by start.sh on macOS/Linux) so the installed deps are visible. WINDOWS users: change the runtimeExecutable to `backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe`. If the venv doesn't exist yet, run ./start.sh (mac/linux) or start.bat (windows) ONCE to create it before launching Preview.
